quote: I inherited my mother's BCI. Sometimes I crave foods I've never tasted. Sometimes I miss a man I've never met. I think he was my father. She never told me his name, but her implant remembers his hands.
source: Personal account, recorded at a Ghost Weight support group
context: Ghost Weight carriers live with inherited sensory memories that blur the boundary between self and ancestor. The support groups are informal and unrecognized by medical authorities.
